order: Draw up the delta re-review order and its executor report for the round-5c fixes. Pin the review to the two commits spanning the round-5b and round-5c checkpoints, enumerating each one individually. Register the reference runner's locked-worktree single-force sweep limitation only as a follow-on item for its own lane — it must never be folded into this review's findings, since it is a pre-existing runner constraint, not a problem the round-5c fix itself introduced. Add only the order and the executor report as new files under roster/: touch no existing roster record, and leave every prior round's file byte-unchanged. Scope the audit strictly to what changed between the two pinned commits. State explicitly, as its own line, that a clean verdict on this exact pin is what clears the pending work orders out of revise status, and that the follow-on note must not be read as a blocking finding against this pin.
